text: Perdurantism analyzes persistence through time in terms of an object's having distinct ___ parts at different times, on analogy with its spatial parts.
explanation: Temporal parts (stages) are the hallmark of perdurantism/four-dimensionalism, and they let it solve the problem of temporary intrinsics: a straight t1-stage and a bent t2-stage each have their shape simpliciter, so no single thing bears incompatible properties. Endurantism, by contrast, denies temporal parts.
